classification: cross-portfolio C1 closure; normalized evidence and quote basis, not CAD, payload mass, production cost or acceptance specification

common_accounting_boundary.windows: same unknown channel windows; not credited in throughput or prescriptions; C02 camera study must sweep zero, 0.5 and 1.0 mm optical thickness
common_accounting_boundary.electronics: same channel electronics and harness allowances; absent values are not invented
common_accounting_boundary.focus: two independent channel focus functions for all architectures; range travel known first-order, thermal/mechanism allowance open
common_accounting_boundary.cells_baffles_structure: existing geometry and scalable area proxies retained; local cells, baffles and flight margins absent from all complete-mass claims
common_accounting_boundary.qualification: -25 to +50 C operating requirement retained; other flight environments unspecified and requested before quotation
common_accounting_boundary.pricing_note: comparison breakpoints only, not forecast quantities; NRE and recurring price must be separated

coating_count_sensitivity.limitations: excludes refractive surfaces, windows, absorption, scatter, polarization, QE and spectral transition
